title: VoiceStudio — focused hero art direction v4
script: A solo dev just open sourced a free version of ElevenLabs, and it's already past 36,000 stars. So instead of paying ElevenLabs every month to clone your voice, you can now do it on your own computer, even on the 10 year old laptop you have sitting around in the basement. It's called VoiceStudio, and you give it a short clip of you talking, and it can read anything back in your voice. And cloning your voice is just the start because it turns any book into an audiobook, types out whatever you want to say, and writes a transcript of any recording. But here's the part that's even crazier. It can dub your videos into 646 languages, which means stop paying any more bills, since it runs on your computer and your voice never has to get uploaded anywhere. For the link and setup, comment Voice.
